source: Install the Oz Slack integration to trigger agents from any channel or DM.
target: 安装 Oz Slack 集成，即可从任意频道或私信触发 Agent。

source: Build programmatic agents using Oz's TypeScript and Python SDKs.
target: 使用 Oz 的 TypeScript 和 Python SDK 构建可编程 Agent。

source: Set team or personal secrets for agents using the `oz secret` command.
target: 使用 `oz secret` 命令为 Agent 设置团队或个人密钥。

source: View all your agent runs and their status in the Oz web app.
target: 在 Oz Web 应用中查看所有 Agent 运行及其状态。

source: Join any Oz cloud agent run in real-time using Agent Session Sharing.
target: 使用 Agent Session Sharing 实时加入任意 Oz 云端 Agent 运行。

source: Set up recurring agents that run on cron schedules for automated maintenance.
target: 设置按 cron 计划运行的周期性 Agent，用于自动维护。

source: Create agents that automatically fix bugs when issues are filed in Linear.
target: 创建 Agent，在 Linear 中提交 issue 时自动修复 bug。

source: Build agents that respond to CI failures and attempt automatic fixes.
target: 构建 Agent 来响应 CI 失败并尝试自动修复。

source: Run agents from GitHub Actions using the `oz-agent-action`.
target: 使用 `oz-agent-action` 从 GitHub Actions 运行 Agent。

source: Call the Oz REST API to trigger agents from any backend service or internal tool.
target: 调用 Oz REST API，从任意后端服务或内部工具触发 Agent。

source: Create reusable environments with Docker images for consistent agent execution.
target: 使用 Docker 镜像创建可复用环境，确保 Agent 执行一致。

source: Share agent session links with your team for collaborative debugging.
target: 与团队共享 Agent 会话链接以协作调试。

source: Use the `--share` flag with the Oz CLI to enable session sharing from anywhere.
target: 在 Oz CLI 中使用 `--share` 标志，即可从任意位置启用会话共享。

source: Fork a completed Oz cloud agent session into Warp to continue the work locally.
target: 将已完成的 Oz 云端 Agent 会话复刻到 Warp，以便在本地继续工作。

source: Build internal tools that use agents to answer questions from your databases.
target: 构建使用 Agent 回答数据库问题的内部工具。

source: Create a scheduled agent to clean up stale feature flags every week.
target: 创建计划 Agent，每周清理过期 feature flag。

source: Tag @Oz in Linear issues to automatically investigate and propose fixes.
target: 在 Linear issue 中标记 @Oz，以自动调查并提出修复。

source: Run agents on remote dev boxes or CI runners using the Oz CLI.
target: 使用 Oz CLI 在远程开发机或 CI runner 上运行 Agent。

source: Configure MCP servers to give Oz cloud agents access to GitHub, Linear, and Sentry.
target: 配置 MCP server，让 Oz 云端 Agent 访问 GitHub、Linear 和 Sentry。

source: Use `oz agent run` to kick off tasks without opening the Warp terminal.
target: 使用 `oz agent run` 启动任务，无需打开 Warp 终端。

source: View your teammates' agent runs in the Oz web app for shared visibility.
target: 在 Oz Web 应用中查看团队成员的 Agent 运行，以共享可见性。

source: Build agents that automatically triage and label incoming GitHub issues.
target: 构建 Agent，自动分流并标记新进入的 GitHub issue。

source: Set up an agent to generate daily summaries of newly opened issues.
target: 设置 Agent，每天生成新开 issue 的摘要。

source: Create an agent that automatically reviews PRs and suggests improvements.
target: 创建 Agent，自动审查 PR 并提出改进建议。

source: Use `oz environment create` to define reproducible execution contexts.
target: 使用 `oz environment create` 定义可复现的执行上下文。

source: Trigger agents from webhooks to respond to production incidents.
target: 通过 webhook 触发 Agent，以响应生产事故。

source: Build an agent that restarts services or scales deployments when alerts fire.
target: 构建 Agent，在告警触发时重启服务或扩缩部署。

source: Use personal secrets for credentials that should only be used by your agents.
target: 使用个人密钥保存仅供你的 Agent 使用的凭据。

source: Use team secrets for shared infrastructure credentials across all agents.
target: 使用团队密钥保存所有 Agent 共享的基础设施凭据。

source: Create an agent that runs nightly to check for dependency updates.
target: 创建每晚运行的 Agent，用于检查依赖更新。

source: Build an agent that automatically formats and lints code on a schedule.
target: 构建按计划自动格式化和 lint 代码的 Agent。

source: Use `oz schedule create` to set up cron-triggered agents.
target: 使用 `oz schedule create` 设置由 cron 触发的 Agent。

source: Pause and resume scheduled agents without deleting them using `oz schedule pause`.
target: 使用 `oz schedule pause` 暂停和恢复计划 Agent，而无需删除它们。

source: Use `oz mcp list` to see which MCP servers are available to your agents.
target: 使用 `oz mcp list` 查看 Agent 可用的 MCP server。

source: Build an internal Slack bot that delegates coding tasks to Oz agents.
target: 构建内部 Slack bot，将编码任务委派给 Oz Agent。

source: Create an agent that responds to @mentions in Slack threads with full context.
target: 创建 Agent，在 Slack 线程中带完整上下文响应 @ 提及。

source: Use the Oz TypeScript SDK to build custom automation pipelines.
target: 使用 Oz TypeScript SDK 构建自定义自动化流水线。

source: Use the Oz Python SDK to integrate agents into your data pipelines.
target: 使用 Oz Python SDK 将 Agent 集成到你的数据流水线中。

source: Monitor agent success rates and runtimes using the Oz API.
target: 使用 Oz API 监控 Agent 成功率和运行时长。

source: Build a dashboard that tracks all agent activity across your team.
target: 构建仪表盘，跟踪整个团队的所有 Agent 活动。
